findings.title: Negative-dimensions test case expects the wrong error message
findings.claim: The case expects "do not fit in 4 bytes" but the code checks for negative dimensions first and returns "negative dimensions -3", so the subtest fails.

findings.title: Test comment's 32-bit wrap claim is never actually exercised
findings.claim: The comment claims the constants make the wrap land on a 32-bit target, but GOARCH=386 go vet fails on a dependency so the package never builds on 32-bit and this coverage never runs.

findings.title: NULL scanned into *any now errors instead of decoding to nil
findings.claim: The new t == nil guard runs before the data == nil handling, so a NULL value for an element type with no Go type now errors instead of decoding to nil; no test covers this.

findings.title: Nested-vector error message doesn't name the inner element type
findings.claim: Zero() discards the error from NewWithError, so the message for a nested vector names neither the inner element type nor the dimension.

findings.title: Saturation branch in vectorElemMinSize has no test
findings.claim: The saturation branch in vectorElemMinSize is untested.

findings.title: getCassandraLongType has no direct test for unknown type names
findings.claim: getCassandraLongType is only reached indirectly through wireVectorType and lacks a direct test for unknown names.

findings.title: Duplicate guard condition in two branches could be merged
findings.claim: marshal.go:998 and marshal.go:1007 share the identical guard info.Dimensions > 0 && data != nil; one block could do the bound check and then the fast-path switch.

findings.title: Commits and PR body carry AI attribution against the user's global rule
findings.claim: Commits 0276a66 and 78891dd carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer, and the PR body ends with a "Generated with Claude Code" line.

findings.title: Behavior change not recorded in CHANGELOG or godoc as CONTRIBUTING.md requires
findings.claim: CONTRIBUTING.md asks for changed behaviour to be recorded in CHANGELOG.md and functional changes in godoc, but CHANGELOG.md doesn't exist and neither Unmarshal nor VectorType godoc mentions the change.

findings.title: Commits don't reference an issue as CONTRIBUTING.md's format expects
findings.claim: Neither commit has a "Patch by …; reviewed by … for #####" line or references an issue, though the conventional subject style matches recent practice on main.

findings.title: Stale comment: "nil/empty and dim=0 fall through" no longer fully accurate
findings.claim: The comment says nil/empty and dim=0 fall through to the generic path, but an empty non-nil payload with dim>0 is now rejected by the bound, so only nil data and dim=0 actually fall through.

findings.title: Stale "// basic type" comment now also covers the opaque custom-type branch
findings.claim: The "// basic type" comment now also covers the branch that returns an opaque named custom type.

findings.title: Three type-switches classifying vector element types must be kept in sync
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize, vectorFixedElemSize and isVectorVariableLengthType all classify the same types; adding a type to one but not the others makes the computed lower bound wrong, and TestVectorElemMinSize covers only some types.

findings.title: New makeVectorType test helper overlaps with existing helpers and can disagree with itself
findings.claim: makeVectorType(elem, elemName, dim) generalizes the existing makeDoubleVectorType and makeFloat32VectorType, but taking both elem and elemName lets the two disagree.

findings.title: wireVectorType helper name doesn't convey that it parses via readTypeInfo
findings.claim: wireVectorType parses a type through readTypeInfo rather than building one by hand, but its name doesn't say that.

findings.title: Wrap rationale is explained redundantly in three separate places
findings.claim: The wrap rationale appears in marshal.go:986-991, again in the test comment, and again in the PR body.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize godoc describes prior behavior rather than current function
findings.claim: The godoc explains what happened before the change ("without the recursion…") rather than describing what the function does now.

findings.title: TotalAlloc test is non-parallel but measures a process-wide counter
findings.claim: The test measures a process-wide allocation counter; flakiness risk is low given the 128 KiB margin, but goroutines leaked by earlier tests can inflate the count.

findings.title: PR body's claim that every new test fails against pristine is false for several tests
findings.claim: Several new tests (TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads, TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType, and the concrete-destination control subtests) would pass on base as intended non-regression guards, contradicting the PR body.

findings.title: PR body misdescribes how short-payload cases fail against base
findings.claim: The short-payload cases fail on base by returning zero values, not with the panic messages the PR body lists.

findings.title: PR body's linked issues don't resolve
findings.claim: gh issue view returns "Could not resolve" for #1091 (the Refs: link), #1085, #1086, #1106 and #1093, so the "Lands with #1093" dependency claim points at nothing and the PR body is the only spec.

findings.title: Behavior change for NULL with negative dimensions is undescribed in PR body
findings.claim: A NULL value with negative dimensions now errors instead of decoding to a nil slice, but the PR body's "Behaviour change" paragraph mentions only short or empty non-NULL payloads.

findings.title: PR body's "keeps that name" claim for unknown types holds on only one path
findings.claim: helpers.go:222 and :267 still return an unnamed NewNativeType(TypeCustom) on parse errors, so the body's claim that unknown type names are kept holds only for the branch at helpers.go:280-284.

findings.title: No new blocking or cancellation paths affecting when calls complete
findings.claim: There are no new waits, blocking or cancellation paths; decoding only returns errors earlier on the same goroutine.

findings.title: Dimension bound check runs before every use of Dimensions, preventing overflow
findings.claim: The bound runs before every use of Dimensions, and after it the fast-path multiplications can't overflow.

findings.title: Nested vector scanned into interface{} now errors instead of crashing
findings.claim: A nested vector scanned into interface{} now errors instead of crashing.

findings.title: Error message names the unknown type
findings.claim: The error message names the unknown type.
